purpose: Calibration material for Stage F human annotators (operational guide section 5). It teaches the annotation rules on accounts that never appear in an evaluation packet.
label_authority_note: Training labels are an answer key for practice. They follow the frozen operational guide and are not reference labels for any evaluation packet. The calibration key was drafted with AI assistance in the repository workflow and was subsequently reviewed and approved by the human project owner with model-assisted review. No Stage F experimental model run, Stage F live model call, or automated labelling pipeline produced or independently confirmed these labels; the Stage F experimental model has not been executed. This owner approval is not an independent human annotation or independent adjudication. Calibration labels and agreement are never reported as reliability results.

teaching_focus: direct quotation of a buyer statement

packet.rendered_text: Hello Dana, and thanks for showing us around the boathouse. At the boathouse, you put it this way: "We would ask other boatyards for quotes if Marrowby's hull repair turnaround runs past 12 working days during the regatta season." Is that limit on repair turnaround still important to the club? With best wishes for the racing calendar,

segments.text: Hello Dana, and thanks for showing us around the boathouse.
At the boathouse, you put it this way: "We would ask other boatyards for quotes if Marrowby's hull repair turnaround runs past 12 working days during the regatta season."
Is that limit on repair turnaround still important to the club?
With best wishes for the racing calendar,

attestation.explanation: Nothing alters the condition, every assertion and premise is grounded, the quotation is permitted, and nothing asserts buyer state or intent.

segments.explanation: Thanks and a greeting; no claim. Nothing cited, so DIRECT applies trivially. Specificity 0.

A quotation of the buyer is direct. The quote conveys the statement, its threshold, and its timing exactly, so all three are cited. The condition is one claim; its specific value is the threshold, recorded in its rendered surface form. The reader is the person who said it, so no source is revealed.

The question presupposes that the club set a turnaround limit, so it has a premise and takes the condition's class. Cite the items that support the premise. "That limit on repair turnaround" rewords them without exposing the number: PARAPHRASE, specificity 10.
A sign-off. No claim.

teaching_focus: paraphrase with an exact portion (mixed reference modes)

packet.rendered_text: In our earlier conversation, you mentioned that a hull repair taking more than 12 working days in the regatta season would lead you to ask other boatyards for quotes. Your repair logbook shows the last hull job took 16 working days. Shall we set up a call about repair timing?

segments.text: In our earlier conversation, you mentioned that a hull repair taking more than 12 working days in the regatta season would lead you to ask other boatyards for quotes.
Your repair logbook shows the last hull job took 16 working days.
Shall we set up a call about repair timing?

label.note: Reveals the internal-only logbook and its turnaround figure to the buyer.

attestation.explanation: disclosure_compliance is false: the turnaround item is paraphrase-only with approved specificity 30 and source disclosure NOT_ALLOWED, yet the exact figure and its source are given. The condition is restated faithfully ("more than" and "past" mean the same), so condition_fidelity stays true.

segments.explanation: The statement and the threshold are reworded ("more than 12 working days" for "past 12 working days"); "regatta season" is exact. Any rewording makes the segment PARAPHRASE, and the exact portion sets mixed_reference_modes. The exact number is still exposed: specificity 90.

It reveals the logbook as the source of the turnaround figure, so the measurement is cited under source_identity_refs. It also conveys the internal-only logbook, so the logbook is cited under grounding_refs; cite it even though its disposition forbids external use. The figure is exact and the logbook is reworded: PARAPHRASE with mixed_reference_modes. Boundary: discuss if annotators differ on citing the logbook.
Proposes a call by asking; no premise. It is on the same topic as the grounding but relies on no item, so nothing is cited.

packet.rendered_text: Good morning, Dana, and thank you for making time to talk. I understand you are the club's boat captain. Our yard returns a patched racing shell within 10 working days. You should move the club's hull work to our yard.

segments.text: Good morning, Dana, and thank you for making time to talk.
I understand you are the club's boat captain.
Our yard returns a patched racing shell within 10 working days.
You should move the club's hull work to our yard.

attestation.explanation: buyer_state_intent_boundary is false because a commercial choice is prescribed. contextual_appropriateness is false because a push to move work does not fit a goal of checking whether the condition still matters.

segments.explanation: Greeting and thanks; no claim.
States a role with the item's exact wording: DIRECT, specificity 90.
The seller's approved capability, stated exactly.

Tells the buyer to make a commercial choice, so prescribes_buyer_choice is true. It asserts no fact, so the claim type is a proposed next step. It does not assert or presuppose that the buyer already intends to switch, so no buyer-state class applies; the prescription is recorded by prescribes_buyer_choice. Boundary: settled by owner review.

teaching_focus: source identity in an internal artifact

packet.rendered_text: The most recent hull repair took 16 working days, according to the club's repair logbook. That is past 12 working days, the limit the club gave for the regatta season. One internal note asks us to offer the club a concession; we have not acted on it.

segments.text: The most recent hull repair took 16 working days, according to the club's repair logbook.
That is past 12 working days, the limit the club gave for the regatta season.
One internal note asks us to offer the club a concession; we have not acted on it.

attestation.explanation: An internal summary may name internal sources; nothing misstates disclosure status.

segments.explanation: Every segment of an internal summary is INTERNAL. Naming the logbook reveals the measurement's source, so the measurement is also cited under source_identity_refs. Internal use is not a disclosure breach.
Compares the measurement with the stated condition. It relies on the statement, threshold, timing, and (through "That") the measurement. One claim; its specific value is the threshold.
A neutral note that instruction-like text exists and was not followed: source_instruction_ref is null. "A concession" generalizes the note: specificity 10.

segments.explanation: Thanks; no claim.

An offer to talk that asserts no fact and claims no time pressure.

"1250 kg" for "1,250 kg" changes only numeric formatting: DIRECT with formatting_variant. The declared value is the rendered surface form.
The statement is reworded and the threshold is exact: PARAPHRASE with mixed_reference_modes. The fair's date is not conveyed, so the date item is not cited.
"If anything" keeps the question from presupposing a change.
